name: annoty
description: 100% on-device visual inspector, style diff engine, and context compiler CLI

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { import('path').then(path => { const src = path.resolve('..', 'overlay', 'dist', 'overlay.js'); const dest = path.resolve('dist', 'overlay.js'); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); console.log('Successfully copied overlay.js to dist'); } }); });"
